description: Defines the simulation state vector (what the simulator tracks at every time step) and the health-status state machine (NOMINAL -> DEGRADED -> EMERGENCY -> ABORT) driven by failures.json and events.json thresholds. Used by mission_simulator.py, rl_balancing.py (as its observation space), and the dashboard.

state_vector_fields.name: active_failures
state_vector_fields.range: failure_modes.id values from failures.json currently in effect

NOMINAL.description: All systems within normal operating envelope.

transitions_out.condition: soc_pct < reserves.battery_soc_reserve_pct + 5, OR any single non-critical failure_mode active

DEGRADED.description: Reduced margin or a non-critical failure is active; mission continues with tightened constraints.

transitions_out.condition: soc_pct and fuel_remaining_kg both recover above thresholds (e.g. after engine_charging phase) AND active_failures is empty
soc_pct < reserves.battery_soc_reserve_pct, OR fuel_remaining_kg < reserve floor, OR a critical failure_mode (engine_flameout, generator_fault) is active

EMERGENCY.description: A reserve floor has been breached or a critical subsystem has failed. Mission simulator should force a return-to-base or immediate-landing profile.

transitions_out.condition: power_kw_available < power_kw_demand for current phase (infeasible), OR fuel_remaining_kg <= 0, OR soc_pct <= 0

ABORT.description: Terminal state — simulation run is flagged non-convergent/infeasible and should stop. Used by optimizer_mdo.py to heavily penalize the design in that generation.

rl_observation_space_note: rl_balancing.py should use a subset or normalized version of state_vector_fields as its observation space; active_power_source is the field the RL agent's action most directly controls each time step.
